name: delphi-lsp
description: Language support for Delphi and Object Pascal powered by the bundled delphi-lsp server.

delphiLsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Optional path to a `delphi-lsp` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled Windows x64 server.

delphiLsp.serverArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the language server.

delphiLsp.configPath.markdownDescription: Optional path to `delphi-lsp.json`. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder.

delphiLsp.project.markdownDescription: Path to the Delphi `.dproj` project. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder. Ignored when `delphiLsp.configPath` is set.

delphiLsp.delphiDir.markdownDescription: Directory containing Delphi source code. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder. Ignored when `delphiLsp.configPath` is set.

delphiLsp.searchPaths.markdownDescription: Additional source directories to index. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder. Ignored when `delphiLsp.configPath` is set.

delphiLsp.includePaths.markdownDescription: Additional include directories. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder. Ignored when `delphiLsp.configPath` is set.
